services:
  clickhouse:
    image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:23.8
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${STATISTIC_DOCKER_CLICKHOUSE_TCP_PORT:-29000}:9000"
      - "127.0.0.1:${STATISTIC_DOCKER_CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_PORT:-28123}:8123"
    environment:
      CLICKHOUSE_DB: default
      CLICKHOUSE_USER: default
      CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT: "1"
    volumes:
      - clickhouse-data:/var/lib/clickhouse
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "clickhouse-client --query 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null"]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30

  nats:
    image: nats:2.10-alpine
    command: ["-js", "-sd", "/data", "-m", "8222"]
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${STATISTIC_DOCKER_NATS_PORT:-24222}:4222"
      - "127.0.0.1:${STATISTIC_DOCKER_NATS_MONITOR_PORT:-28222}:8222"
    volumes:
      - nats-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8222/healthz"]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30

  nats-bootstrap:
    image: natsio/nats-box:0.14.5
    depends_on:
      nats:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
    volumes:
      - ./scripts/bootstrap-nats.sh:/bootstrap-nats.sh:ro
      - ./nats/learning-analytics-events.json:/streams/learning-analytics-events.json:ro
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/bootstrap-nats.sh"]
    restart: "no"

  ms-go-statistic:
    container_name: ms-go-statistic
    build: .
    depends_on:
      clickhouse:
        condition: service_healthy
      nats-bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - .env.example
    environment:
      STAT_CLICKHOUSE_DSN: tcp://clickhouse:9000?database=default
      STAT_NATS_URL: nats://nats:4222
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${STATISTIC_DOCKER_HTTP_PORT:-28090}:8080"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/internal/health"]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30

volumes:
  clickhouse-data: {}
  nats-data: {}
